title: Moonlit Botanicals — Phyllotaxis Art Print
description:
Created with mathematical code, not an AI image generator.

Botanical geometry beneath a crescent moon. Three stylised flowers follow golden-angle seed spirals and Fibonacci counts, framed by sage-green leaves traced with Bézier curves. Fine cream and ochre lines on midnight blue bring the precision of a botanical diagram to a quiet, celestial composition.

An unframed 12 × 16 inch art print on 200gsm enhanced matte paper, printed to order. Standard US shipping is included.

Room scenes are AI-generated styling mockups, not photographs of a physical sample. Colour, scale and details are illustrative; see the flat artwork image for the exact design. Print sold unframed; frames, furniture and props are not included.
